column4: meaning

the three rates of deflation of $x5$, $x6$, $x7$ (positive constants, dimension 1/length). These are the author's names; they are written upright and never with a subscript. They are *not* components of the metric: the components are $g_{55}$, $g_{66}$, $g_{77}$
the rate of the coordinate $xt$ in a statement that holds for $t=5,6,7$ alike: $\mathrm{rate}_5=\mathrm{g55}$, $\mathrm{rate}_6=\mathrm{g66}$, $\mathrm{rate}_7=\mathrm{g77}$
$\mathrm{g55}+\mathrm{g66}+\mathrm{g77}$, the total rate: the proper volume of the three deflating coordinates falls as $e^{-\mathrm{gsum}\,x4}$ (`gam`: gsum in units of 100 km/s/Mpc)
$\mathrm{g55}^2+\mathrm{g66}^2+\mathrm{g77}^2$ and $\mathrm{g55}\,\mathrm{g66}+\mathrm{g55}\,\mathrm{g77}+\mathrm{g66}\,\mathrm{g77}$; $\mathrm{gsum}^2=\mathrm{gsq}+2\,\mathrm{gprod}$
the three positive constants of the author's metric (his word: const): the values of the scale factors at $x4=0$

the scale factors of the deflating coordinates, $b_t(x4)=\mathrm{const}_t\,e^{-\mathrm{rate}_t\,x4}$: a coordinate distance $dxt$ is the proper length $b_t\,\lvert dxt\rvert$. Always written with the index 5, 6, 7 or $t$ (the letter $b$ without index is a Ginzburg-Landau coefficient of the main registry)
$b_5b_6b_7=\sqrt{\lvert\det g\rvert}$, the proper volume of a unit coordinate cell of the deflating coordinates; $V_d\propto e^{-\mathrm{gsum}\,x4}$

the metrics of the deflating 4+4 and 7+1 spacetimes, $\mathrm{diag}(\eta_{00},\dots,\eta_{44},\eta_{55}b_5^2,\eta_{66}b_6^2,\eta_{77}b_7^2)$ with $\eta=\eta_{1644}$ or $\eta_{1671}$; in both, $g_{tt}=-\mathrm{const}_t^2e^{-2\,\mathrm{rate}_t\,x4}$

coordinate indices with the values $0,\dots,7$ on the deflating spacetimes (only as sub- or superscripts; as stand-alone letters $\mu$, $\nu$, $\lambda$ keep the meanings of the main registry). The capital indices $A,B$ label the orthonormal frame: the frame vector $A$ points along the coordinate $xA$
the orthonormal frame and its inverse: $e^A{}_\mu=\mathrm{diag}(1,1,1,1,1,b_5,b_6,b_7)$
the Christoffel symbols of the deflating metric (three indices; the letter $\Gamma$ with square brackets is the effective action of the main registry)
